text:
Emily Tran: Hey team — PR #17890 is stuck on CI. integ/e2e_kv_cache on windows-shard-3 failed with a snapshot mismatch.
Matthew B: :eyes: can you paste the failing diff?
Emily Tran: here's the tail of the test log:
```
AssertionError: expected 12 keys in cache, got 11
 at tests/kv_cache_integration_test.py:142
ConcurrentWarning: timing variance exceeded threshold
```
Emily Tran: It *looks* like timing nondeterminism rather than a behavior change. But the snapshot diff is small and could be updated if we confirm it's benign.
Sanjay Rao: Do we have recent runtime changes in batching/kv-cache around that PR? If so better to rerun first.
Emily Tran: PR only touches docstrings and a minor refactor. No runtime changes.
Olivia K: I can approve a snapshot update if we run a targeted rerun and confirm it still flakes. Who can trigger a shard rerun?
Matthew B: @ci-bot can we trigger a targeted rerun for 17890 on windows-shard-3?
ci-bot: buildkite: triggered rerun for PR #17890 (windows-shard-3). run id: bk-98234
ci-bot: buildkite: run failed again — same assertion.
Sanjay Rao: OK that's two failures. Suggest a rebase on main and another rerun; sometimes flaky infra causes this.
Emily Tran: rebased and pushed. @ci-bot please rerun.
ci-bot: buildkite: triggered rerun for PR #17890 (windows-shard-3). run id: bk-98235
ci-bot: buildkite: SUCCESS on rerun bk-98235 — tests passed.
Olivia K: Given one pass one fail, I'd prefer one more green before approving snapshot. Can someone run a local reproduce with `pytest tests/kv_cache_integration_test.py::test_cache_consistency -k windows-sim`?
Matthew B: I'll run locally and share logs. If flaky continues, we shouldn't update snapshot, instead mark test flaky and file follow-up.
Emily Tran: Thanks. If Matthew confirms stable locally, Olivia I'll ping you again for snapshot update approval.
Matthew B: local run passed 3/3. Logs show a transient timing warning but assert stable. My vote: allow snapshot update after one more CI green.
Olivia K: OK. I'll wait for the additional CI green then approve the snapshot PR. :+1:
Emily Tran: thanks all — moving PR off the blocker list for now. I'll watch CI and ping when ready.
